Dear {vendor} team,

This is formal written notice that Brightwater Coffee Co. does not wish to renew {agreement}, and we are giving notice of non-renewal. The current term ends on {term_end}.

The agreement states: "{notice_clause}". We are providing this notice within that period, so the agreement should not renew automatically for a further term.

Please confirm in writing that you have received this notice of non-renewal and that {agreement} will end on {term_end} without renewal. Please also let us know if you need anything else from us to close the account.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Kind regards,
{sender}
